top_signals.title: World’s worst-performing stock market hit by fresh MSCI warning
top_signals.summary: Warning from global index provider fuels concerns about investability in south-east Asia’s biggest economy
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Scammer loses $4.8M stored on tampered Ledgers: Asia Express
top_signals.summary: A scammer reportedly lost $4.8M of stolen money after storing the funds on tampered Ledgers. Bitcoin and Ether ETFs launch trading in Thailand and South Korea blocks 27 exchanges.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Blue Owl: Private Credit Redemptions Are Falling
top_signals.summary: James Clarke, Senior Managing Director and Global Head of Institutional Capital at Blue Owl, says redemptions are coming down in private credit following excessive market concerns earlier in the year. He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts and Paul Allen on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: CoreWeave’s slump spotlights growing burden of debt behind AI boom
top_signals.summary: The loss-making cloud company has about $50 billion in debt and has become a focus of concerns that the data-center boom is being fueled by credit.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Red Wings owner responds to backlash from fans calling for team to be sold
top_signals.summary: Captain Dylan Larkin requested a trade this summer, and one of the team's top defensemen remains without a contract. The Red Wings also don't have a permanent general manager.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Japan, South Korea agree to extend $10 billion currency swap arrangement
top_signals.summary: The agreement, originally set to expire at the end of November, is expected to run through November 2029, with its size unchanged.
